business_problem: —Philip Yu, COO, AXA Tianping Property & Casualty Insurance Company Limited
solution_summary: A smart collaboration platform is the foundation vital to AXA Tianping’s digital transformation. The platform, instead of a mashup of multiple products, shall incorporate various solutions with a core, which is Microsoft 365. In the post-pandemic era, for every business team of AXA Tianping, whether forced to work remotely or actively embracing hybrid work to meet business demands, a powerful office application platform could considerably reduce the hassles of remote working, enhance team efficiency, and promote corporate transformation. Microsoft 365 strikes a balance between agility and security, making it the right tool we need for our digital transformation. —Philip Yu, COO, AXA Tianping Property & Casualty Insurance Company Limited

solution_components.name: Microsoft 365
solution_components.role: Provides the collaboration, productivity, and document foundation for modern workplace workflows.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Teams
solution_components.role: Connects users, experts, or frontline staff for collaboration, communication, and workflow execution.

solution_components.name: SharePoint
solution_components.role: Stores and shares documents and structured content used across the workflow.

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: Publishes dashboards and reports so teams can monitor operations and act on live insights.

data_flow: To realize digitization, AXA Tianping focuses on smart office construction for improved business resilience and better office experience, and continues to tap into the value of data to enhance operating efficiency, while ensuring information security and compliance. In addition, it has begun to implement dynamic conditional access policies that continuously evaluate and validate the employees’ secure access ability, and uses the data loss prevention and information protection policies of Microsoft 365 to build a strong fortress of corporate information security.
business_outcome: AXA Tianping is also gradually migrating locally deployed Exchange Server enterprise mailbox to Exchange Online. The cloud mailbox in Microsoft 365 has huge storage space that supports mega attachments.
